noisy_perceiver — DRIVE kendama op

• Data kinds: none → any (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.noisy_perceiver(rng, noise_pos: 'float' = 0.0, noise_vel: 'float' = 0.0) (to call the implementation directly, import kendama; kendama.noisy_perceiver(rng, noise_pos: 'float' = 0.0, noise_vel: 'float' = 0.0); from the registry, opsdrive.get("noisy_perceiver"))

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

知覚に等方ガウス雑音を足す `perceive(t, p, v) → (p̂, v̂)`(位置 σ = noise_pos [m]、速度 σ = noise_vel [m/s])。

負の σ は ValueError。rng = numpy.random.Generator。
